I am a woman of 48 farming this small plot of 0.26 hectares in South South, and because the land is rented and money is always tight in my house, I will not buy chemical fertilizer or improved seed — I will use my own planting material from last season and the little poultry manure I have in my compound. The rain here is good enough, so I do not need irrigation, and me and my children will do all the clearing, planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves since I cannot pay hired workers for such a small piece of land. I will weed two or three times by hand, but I will not spray any chemicals because that costs too much for root crops on rented land.
